evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm after stabilizing near 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 8.9 ppm during growth.
Oxygen continued rising to 24.3 ppm with unchanged growth setpoints.
Oxygen reached 26.0 ppm despite temperature at 750.1 °C, argon at 99.9 sccm, and heater power at 44.7%; temperature and flow remain on target.
Pressure gauge is not installed; null pressure readings provide no evidence of pressure behavior.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and pressure/exhaust-flow and seal-integrity checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
